model_lifetime: construct/hash/place one subject; release all state/weights before constructing next; no simultaneous dense Tide and Transformer
request_boundary: zero state for cold, diagnostic, every warmup and every sample; real continued private state inside each finite request; only one final Timed drain
allocator_boundary: discard diagnostic free blocks before independent warmup; keep warmup cache for normal samples; reset peaks separately per cold/sample
cold_boundary: first invocation of this subject before its workload audit/warmup; preceding subjects can warm process/kernel caches; fresh-process comparisons require separate one-subject launches; excludes import/construction/hash/initial weight and input transfer

observations.prompt_output_ready_definition: first completed call whose returned logical window covers last prompt injection plus full graph-depth delay; conservative terminal-path boundary, not memory causal attribution or language-model TTFT
observations.stable_decode_rule: omit first incremental call; no stable sample when fewer than two decode calls
observations.consumer: materialize backbone readout; synchronize every owner; release each output; no concatenation, task head, checksum reduction or D2H return
observations.timing_boundary: resident-input first call through final drain/readout/output release/context exit and all-owner synchronization; phase intervals include Python scheduling since prior ready boundary
observations.availability_source: separate full-schedule diagnostic at identical parameters/input/precision/execution policy; not a timed support capture

audit.definition: unique Parameter scalars in effective owner/group/source slices; not gradients or physical loads

retention.digest_definition: ordered newline JSON [sample,logical_time,unique_parameters] per actual call; total combined only
